resources.string: Arnav Island notifications on your PC
What plays on your PC, with its controls, and lock, ring, send, camera and paste
Lock your PC, ring it, send photos, take one for its Shelf, paste on it
Your PC’s processor, graphics and memory, live
Your PC’s focus clock, counting down here too
Your PC’s clicks and typing, while it shows this phone

While your PC shows this phone’s screen (you start that in Arnav Island, and Android asks each time), its clicks tap here, dragging swipes, its right button goes back and its typing goes into the field you’re in. Nothing on the screen is read or kept, and nothing is done when the screen isn’t being shown.
